name: CorrosionChemicalProgramTracker
tagline: Coupons, probes, injection rates and lab results against the program – with exceptions, actions and MOC-controlled rate changes.
description: A complete corrosion-management and chemical-treatment app in one Power Apps code component: monitoring schedule per point, evaluation of coupon and ER probe rates, chemical injection checks against the approved program, residual, iron and bacteria results, exceptions with corrective actions and program changes under MOC – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Monitoring schedule per point with overdue, due soon and at-lab states
Corrosion rate limits and severe rate for coupons and ER probes
Injection compliance vs target ± tolerance, critical under-injection
Residual minimum, iron and bacteria limits
Corrective actions with critical action window and overdue tracking
Program changes with justification, MOC threshold and approved rate as target
Lab turnaround alerts, missed readings with reasons
Bulk missed / cancelled / reschedule, delete with undo, CSV export
Demo mode with fictional Brolga Creek Field data
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
